description: The Pi's wireless neighborhood watch: reads the Wi-Fi neighborhood the platform already sees and files new, spoofed, vanished and degraded wireless signals.
name: airwaves

signals.description: A BSSID never seen before appeared, broadcasting an SSID the neighborhood has not known.
signals.name: new_access_point

signals.description: A known SSID appeared from a new BSSID, or a known AP dropped to weaker security: a possible evil twin.
signals.name: evil_twin_suspect

signals.description: A known access point stayed absent for gone_after_scans successful scans and is given up as gone.
signals.name: access_point_gone

signals.description: The box's own Wi-Fi link roamed to a different BSSID or its signal fell by link_drop_db or more.
signals.name: link_degraded
